outline:
Multimedia systems and design course consists of the following topics:
1. Introduction to Multimedia Systems
2. Image Reduction
3. Noise in image
4. Edge detection
schedule:
1. Introduction to Multimedia Systems (4weeks)
2. Image Reduction (4weeks)
3. Noise in image (4weeks)
4. Edge detection (4weeks)
